name: journal
description: Decision journal (generic_utils.journal): one small append-only DuckDB that keeps, per session (one briefing pack), the market regime, a point-in-time snapshot of every covered name (pack reads, not raw fields the panel store already holds), the agent's calls (only when a course, grade or plan changes) with their reason text stored once, and dated notes (OUTSIDE news, sentiment, lessons); then measures what followed on the panel store (raw, excess vs the median store name, signed by the call's direction, path low / high, kill and band touches) at 1 day to 6 months. Knobs only: coverage, fields, buckets and studies are readings, not cutoffs; no course is chosen here.

coverage._note: Which board rows get a snapshot each session: the condition below on PACK/board names, plus every symbol the judgment rules on and the Book. Older packs without a board use briefing_pack.duckdb names / book.
coverage.board_where: COALESCE(pack_lists, '') <> '' OR in_book OR named OR earn_week IN ('W0', 'W1')

snap_fields._note: journal column -> source columns tried in order (board names first, then pack names). Numbers are stored as REAL, text as VARCHAR. Keep this short: every column is paid for on every row.

regime._note: Session regime from PACK/sentiment market_sentiment.duckdb (the newest daily row at or before the session) and the live patterns; alpha states from PACK/alpha_model state.

course_classes._note: First match wins on the upper-cased Course. sign +1: the call wants the name to beat the median (held or bought); -1: the call stood aside or sold (right when the name lagged); 0: no direction (watch). Signed excess = sign x excess.

buckets._note: Reading buckets for the studies (edges split value < edge). Labels are what the page shows.
